content:
This Commercial Lease Addendum ('Addendum') supplements the Master Ejari Tenancy Agreement registered with the Dubai Land Department (RERA), executed as of September 29, 2026.

1. LEASED PREMISES: Unit 1402, Level 14, Commercial Tower A, Dubai International Financial Centre, encompassing 3,850 sq. ft. of Grade-A office space.

2. RENTAL PAYMENTS & VAT: Annual rent of AED 580,000 shall be remitted via four (4) equal post-dated cheques. Pursuant to UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017, Value Added Tax (VAT) at 5% applies to all commercial leases and will be billed separately with valid Tax Invoices.

3. FIT-OUT PERIOD & DEPOSIT: Landlord grants Tenant a ninety (90) day rent-free fit-out moratorium commencing from handover. Tenant provides a refundable security deposit of AED 58,000 against property damage.

4. STATUTORY COMPLIANCE: Both parties agree that electronic execution of this contract complies with UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021 on Electronic Transactions and Trust Services, carrying full evidentiary weight before Dubai Courts and DIFC Courts.
